QuestInfo.name: The Seventh and Eighth Choice
QuestInfo.1: What's happening, and what have you done? You've got to go to #r#m307000120:##k and find #b#p2560114:##k as soon as possible.
QuestInfo.2: Now that you've made the decision to go back to quarters and take the neutralizer, you started to wonder whether you're doing the right thing.\r\nEven if you're not, it's time to stop running from your fears.
QuestInfo.0: When you return from the temple, you discover an #bevening primrose#k bloom on your desk, and you can't help but wonder who brought it.
